opening.argument: The speaker presents OneCoin as a business and investment opportunity, pairing claims of rapid appreciation and company growth with a direct invitation to join. He cites “It has an annual valuation of more than 700% of appreciation in less than a year.” He also describes it as a “multi-level marth company” and points to “1,300,000 distributors members One Coins” as evidence of the opportunity's expanding network. The appeal is therefore built around both financial growth claims and recruitment into a tiered business structure. His instruction to “come be part of this business” makes participation the requested next step, placing recruitment at the center of the pitch rather than merely discussing cryptocurrency.
